title: Requirement v1
description: config/requirements/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F2a): a requirement with no other home, one file each. Its statement is testable (EARS: ubiquitous, event-driven, state-driven, unwanted behaviour or optional feature).

type.description: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148: what kind of requirement. legal: an obligation from law or a licence (LGPD, content licences), D-321.

state.description: The declared states; implemented and verified are derived from links.

verification.description: How the requirement is verified: by a test (the default), or, for a runtime property no unit test proves (a duration, a rate, the absence of polling), by its own validation met in use (PADRAO-DEV F8a, as F5 planned).
